title: WIP trailer for my game
author: Fizassist1
selftext:
Alright everybody, I fell into the temptation of having codex make a trailer for my game after seeing others' successes with it.  I'm building the game in godot, and godot had tools already available for codex to grab footage and make the trailer.  I initially gave codex a full second by second description of what I wanted, but I still had to iterate twice to get it to this point.

My problem?  Each iteration is using my full 5hr usage when using Astra light.  Should I use a lesser model or just iterate every 5 hours on this?  

I'm aware that the music and sound effects need work.  My game currently doesn't have any sound implemented, so codex didn't have much to work off of.

I will take feedback for either the game itself, or the trailer, but please be constructive. :)
